# Three.js 0.180.0

Vendored from the official npm package `three@0.180.0` (MIT; see LICENSE).
Files are unmodified: build/three.module.js, build/three.core.js and examples/jsm/controls/OrbitControls.js.
No CDN or package install is required when running the website.

Purpose: local WebGL rendering of illustrative sensor geometry. This dependency does not create, estimate or transmit battery measurements.
